for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    i,o=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']

    # bar analysis: contiguous horizontal segments per color
    def bars(g,label=''):
        b={}
        for r,row in enumerate(g):
            c=0
            while c<W:
                if g[r][c]:
                    c2=c
                    while c2<W and g[r][c2]==g[r][c]: c2+=1
                    if g[r][c] not in b or len(b[g[r][c]])==0: pass

        print(f'{r}:')
        print('  in :',' '.join(str(x) for x in i[r]))

from collections import Counter
# load fresh state
import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for name in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    chg=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    print('===',name,'n_changes',len(chg))
    # distinct columns involved
    cols=set(c for _,c,_,_ in chg)
    rows_=set(r for r,_,_,_ in chg)
    print('   changed cols',sorted(cols),'rows',min(rows_),'-',max(rows_))
    # bar positions
    bgc=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bgc]
    print('   input non-bg:',cells)

from collections import Counter
def span_of(cs):
    cs=sorted(set(cs))
    sp=[];cur=[cs[0]]
    for x in cs[1:]:
        if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
        else: sp.append(cur);cur=[x]
    sp.append(cur);return sp

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    Iset=set((r,c) for r,c,v in cells)
    # bar cells: in runs of length>=2 along their row
    bar=[]; mark=[]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        cnt=sum(1 for rr,cc,vv in cells if rr==r and abs(cc-c)<=1 and (rr,cc) in Iset)
        if cnt>=2: bar.append((r,c,v))
        else: mark.append((r,c,v))
    bar.sort()
    tr=min(r for r,_,_ in bar); br=max(r for r,_,_ in bar)
    ts=[c for r,c,_ in bar if r==tr]; bs=[c for r,c,_ in mark if False]; bs=[c for r,c,v in bar if r==br]
    top_span=span_of(ts); bot_span=span_of(bs)
    assert len(top_span)==len(bot_span)==1, (top_span,bot_span)
    T0,tope=top_span[0],top_span[1]
    B0,bote=bot_span[0],bot_span[1]
    s=B0-T0  # shift so top col + s = bottom col
    def partner(c):
        return c+s
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    # marker column fills vertical line between bars at that column
    for r,c,v in mark:
        p=partner(c)
        segs=[]
        if T0<=c<=tope: segs=[(tr+1,r-1)]
        elif B0<=c<=bote: segs=[(r+1,br-1)]
        elif not (B0<=p<=bote or T0<=c<=tope or B0<=c<=bote):
            segs=[(min(tr,br),max(tr,br))]
        for start,end_ in segs:
            if end_>=start:
                for rr in range(start,end_+1):
                    if (rr,c) not in Iset: out[rr][c]=v
    return out

def features(name):
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(I,bg)
    marks=[c_[0] for c_ in cs if len(c_)==1]; bars=[c_ for c_ in cs if len(c_)>1]
    added={(r,c):O[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]}
    # group changes into vertical runs per column (contiguous changed cells)
    def runs(lst):
        out=[]; cur=[]
        for x in lst+[None]:
            if x is None: out.append(cur); cur=[]
            elif len(cur)==0 or x==lst[lst.index(x)-1][0] if False else True: pass
        return out
    # instead: per column, find maximal contiguous change intervals
    cols=[(c,sorted({d[0] for d in added if d[1]==c})) for c in range(W)]
    info={}
    for c,rs in cols:
        if not rs: continue
        r0=min(rs); r1=max(rs)
        # is it a contiguous interval?
        info[c]=(r0,r1,[int(O[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
    return bg,marks,[ (min(b),max(b),(min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b)))+set(I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in b) for b in bars],info
for name in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    bg,marks,bars_,info=features(name)
    print('===',name)
    print(' marks:',marks)
    for b in bars_: print(' bar:',b)
    print(' changes:',{c:(r0,r1) for c,(r0,r1,v) in info.items()})

def analyze(name):
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    bgv=int(Counter(I.ravel().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0])
    H,W=I.shape
    chg={(r,c,int(O[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]!=O[r,c]}
    # original non-bg objects (bars/dots)
    nb=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]!=bgv]
    return I,O,bgv,nb,chg
for name in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    I,O,bgv,nb,chg=analyze(name)
    print('===',name,'bg',bgv)
    print('  nonbg:',nb)
    print('  changed colors->:',sorted(set(c for _,_,c in chg)))
    print('  changed cells:')
    for r,c,v in sorted(chg): print('   ',(r,c),'->',v)

def fills(name):
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    bgc=max(set(x for row in I for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in I))
    chg=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    return bgc,H,W,chg
for name in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:

    # grouped fills: contiguous columns
    cols=sorted({c for _,c,_,_ in chg})
    for c in cols:
        rows=sorted(r for r,_ ,_,_ in [(r,c,0,0) for r,_ in [(rr,cc) for rr,cc,io,o in chg if cc==c]])
        rows=[r for r,_ in [(rr,cc) for rr,cc,io,o in chg if cc==c]]
        spans=[];cur=[]
        for r in sorted(rows): cur.append(r)
        for i,r in enumerate(cur):
            if i==0 or r!=cur[i-1]+1: spans.append(tuple(cur));cur=[]
            cur.append(r)
        if cur: spans.append(tuple(cur))
        print('   col',c,'rows',spans)
